name: Clipboard Manager
tagline: A searchable clipboard history with pinned snippets and text transforms — offline, tray-based.
description: Keeps a searchable history of what you copy, lets you pin frequently-used snippets, and re-copy any past entry with a click. Includes quick text transforms (upper/lower/title case, trim, join/split lines, base64, slugify) applied on paste. History stays on your machine and can be cleared or excluded per app. Lightweight and always available.
